notes.title: Devlog 2 - DEMO update!
notes.content:
In this update you will found:

- Fixed birds sounds and view audio settings,
- 1 more demo level,
- Fixed Demo endscreen,
- Parking slot doesn't trigger while there is other wrong object in trigger,
- Parking slot doesn't trigger when forklift lifting something.
- More levels has birds and they spawn faster.
- Now you can stack car on car!

And finally!
- Birds now can land on your forklift if you doesnt move!

Have a nice day!
